body:
- From a technical point of view, I thing BEM classes should be defined in the widget, and then passed to the React component. This will let us share some components (like `refinementList`) but still allow them to have different classes (`ais-toggle` and `ais-menu` instead of all having `ais-refinement-list).
- If we remove the ability to override classes of default templates we lose the ability to do a Bootstrap-compliant theme easily (one can still override the whole template). I have no problem dropping that for the v1, but we need to be clear on that.
- Ok for the `default.css`. We'll still need to see what will go inside and will go in the bigger themes.
